mapper.select: SELECT m.id,m.storage_key,m.poster_storage_key FROM t_media m WHERE m.status IN ('STAGED','DELETED') AND m.created_at<DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(),INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_note_media n WHERE n.media_id=m.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_practice_media p WHERE p.media_id=m.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_user u WHERE u.avatar_media_id=m.id) ORDER BY m.id LIMIT 100 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
